examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A band heading with an anchor: the h2 takes the id, a copy-link button appears when the heading is hovered or focused, and the band's action sits on the right.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import SectionHeader from '@aziontech/webkit/section-header'
</script>

<template>
  <SectionHeader
    title="Payment information"
    description="Where invoices are sent, and whether the plan renews on its own."
    anchor="payment-information"
  >
    <template #actions>
      <Button
        label="Update"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
      />
    </template>
  </SectionHeader>
</template>

examples.name: WithActions
examples.summary: The Billing payment-methods heading, with the outlined Add payment method action and its plus glyph on the right.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import SectionHeader from '@aziontech/webkit/section-header'
</script>

<template>
  <SectionHeader
    title="Payment methods"
    description="Every card on the account. Invoices are charged to the default one."
    anchor="payment-methods"
  >
    <template #actions>
      <Button
        label="Add payment method"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
        icon="pi pi-plus"
      />
    </template>
  </SectionHeader>
</template>
